beats.headline: Marked and programmed
beats.text: Heat three, with Gluteus Maxx at the wheel and a dragon-faced Draconian on One Fine Pig's APV manning a heavy machine gun. Carl marks the Draconian with two denial-of-service missiles and the gun with two more, to fire as soon as they are free; he wants that team slowed, not killed. The other four in his eight-pack launcher he programs too. By now every team will have shields, and direct attacks will likely do nothing. This is a Rosetta idea, a different recipe from the potion balls but just as insidious.

beats.headline: Goo, not boom
beats.text: Team Sparkles is rolling far ahead on some sort of rocket. Carl aims the launcher straight up and fires out the back of the speeding truck, and the eight missiles spiral off, four toward One Fine Pig and four toward Sparkles. They are not designed to explode. Three slam into Sparkles' bush, which veers off spinning in panicked circles, its round shield covered in a thick membrane of green slime so they cannot see. Drop the shield and the sludge falls into the vines, which Mordecai insists will slow them to a crawl.

beats.headline: Too early over the pigs
beats.text: A message from Chiyome, somewhere behind: the missiles meant for the Fine Pigs detonated too early, and the goo went all over the place, Onikuma included. Her team cannot see, the road is too steep for their Oni, who keeps stumbling, and the Jugglers are somewhere back with them. Carl tells her to move to the right side; they will toss the tunnels if a third wave comes.

beats.headline: Goo on the loop
beats.text: In Satan's Water Park, Florin has Denial of Service missiles too, and has said he will hit Team Sparkles just as they start the loop-de-loop: too slow, and they drop out and start again. Now they are on his tail and about to bump him, so he fires. When Satan headbutts the whole loop over and both vehicles come tumbling down near the food truck, the Sparkles vine is on fire and covered with goo.
